message.subject: New message from {sender}
message.body: {count, plural, =1 {{sender} sent you a message on The SaaS Harbor.} other {{sender} sent you # messages on The SaaS Harbor.}}
message.footer: You get one email per conversation until you read it, and it never contains the message.

reports.subject: {count, plural, =1 {1 open report on The SaaS Harbor} other {# open reports on The SaaS Harbor}}
reports.body: {count, plural, =1 {A report waits for review.} other {# reports wait for review.}}
reports.footer: You get at most one of these emails an hour, because you are an admin.

decision.person: A person made this decision, not an automated system.
decision.personContact: A person made this decision, not an automated system. If you think it is wrong, write to {contact} and say why.
decision.footer: This email is about your account, so it is sent even if you turned other emails off.

hideSaas.subject: An admin hid your product {name}
hideSaas.body: An admin hid {name} on The SaaS Harbor. It is not shown anywhere on the site, and you can still edit or delete it.

restoreSaas.subject: Your product {name} is shown again
restoreSaas.body: An admin reviewed {name} again, and it is shown on The SaaS Harbor again.

suspendAccount.subject: Your account on The SaaS Harbor is suspended
suspendAccount.body: An admin suspended your account. Your profile and products are hidden, and you cannot send messages or reports. You can still sign in, edit your products and delete your account.

restoreAccount.subject: Your account on The SaaS Harbor is active again
restoreAccount.body: An admin lifted the suspension of your account. Your profile and products are shown again, and you can send messages.

sentence.top: {name} reached the top {place} on the leaderboard of verified revenue on The SaaS Harbor.
sentence.first: {name} reached first place on the leaderboard of verified revenue on The SaaS Harbor.

milestone.card: We made a card for it. When you share the link, the card shows with your post.

share.mrr: {name} just reached {amount} MRR, verified on The SaaS Harbor.
share.top: {name} is now in the top {place} on The SaaS Harbor's leaderboard of verified revenue.
share.first: {name} is now #1 on The SaaS Harbor's leaderboard of verified revenue.

milestone.footer: You get this email once for each milestone your product reaches while its MRR is shared.

outcome.subject: Your report has been reviewed

about.message: An admin reviewed your report about a message you received.
about.saas: An admin reviewed your report about the product {name}.
about.profile: An admin reviewed your report about the profile of {name}.

outcome.actioned: They took action, for example by hiding the product or suspending the account.
outcome.dismissed: They found that it does not break the terms or the law, so they took no action.
outcome.footer: The reported user is not told who reported. This email is sent for every report you make.

confirmation.subject: Confirm your email for The SaaS Harbor
confirmation.heading: Confirm your email
confirmation.preview: Confirm your email address to finish creating your account.
confirmation.body: Thanks for signing up for The SaaS Harbor. Confirm your email address to finish creating your account.
confirmation.footer: The link works once and expires after an hour, and you can open it on any device. If you did not sign up, ignore this email and no account is created.

recovery.subject: Reset your password for The SaaS Harbor
recovery.heading: Reset your password
recovery.preview: Choose a new password for your account on The SaaS Harbor.
recovery.body: Someone asked to reset the password for your account on The SaaS Harbor. Choose a new password with the button below.
recovery.footer: The link works once and expires after an hour, and you can open it on any device. If you did not ask for this, ignore this email and your password stays the same.

emailChange.subject: Confirm your new email address for The SaaS Harbor
emailChange.heading: Confirm your new email address
emailChange.preview: Confirm the change of your email address on The SaaS Harbor.
emailChange.body: Someone asked to change the email address of your account on The SaaS Harbor from {email} to {newEmail}. The change is made once it is confirmed from both addresses.
emailChange.footer: The link works once and expires after an hour, and you can open it on any device. If you did not ask for this, ignore this email and your email address stays the same.
